customManagers.description: The fisherman git source in each frontend Flatpak manifest. It must name the same commit as the fisherman submodule gitlink (tests/unit/test_shared_probe.py::TestFishermanPin), so it tracks the same ref: the prod branch in .gitmodules.

packageRules.description: fedora base image major bumps are IGNORED (not even proposed): the fedora:46/rawhide image's dnf repos serve fc45-built packages with a keyring mismatch, breaking container builds (same upstream defect as tuna-os/tacklebox#205, tuna-os/bluefin-cli#167). automerge:false alone did not stop renovate elsewhere -- tacklebox PRs #209/#211 auto-merged anyway -- so enabled:false is what prevents PR creation. e2e.yml's kde job and screenshots-kde.yml both run in quay.io/fedora/fedora:45. Carried over from frontends/kde/renovate.json, which Renovate never read: it reads only the repository root. Remove this rule once the upstream image is consistent.
tuna-os/* reusable workflows and actions are first-party and intentionally track @main; do not pin them (docs/RELEASE.md, Action pinning).

fisherman: the submodule gitlink and the four Flatpak manifest pins move in ONE PR (TestFishermanPin fails if they disagree) and merge on green. Both track fisherman's prod branch, which only advances after fisherman's promote gate (its E2E matrix green plus a soak), so only released fisherman commits are pinned.
